name: clean-language
description: Write, check and compile Clean Language code from your AI assistant.
long_description: Clean Language is a type-safe language that compiles to WebAssembly, with JavaScript-like readability and Rust-like safety. This server gives AI assistants the language reference, the full specification, a type checker and the compiler, so they write correct Clean code instead of guessing. The compiler is included; nothing else needs to be installed.
